overall_goal: Perform various cleaning, organizing, and preparatory tasks in the kitchen

goals.description: Wash the saucepan and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person cleans the saucepan with soap and a brush, rinses it, places it on the drying rack, and dries their hands.
The person retrieves the vacuum cleaner, turns it on, and vacuums the kitchen floor to remove debris.

goals.description: Put away butter, knife, and digital scale
goals.rationale: The person stores the butter, places the used knife in the dishwasher, and puts the digital scale back into its drawer.

goals.description: Set up digital scales for weighing
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the digital scales, turns them on, and tares them with a bowl to prepare for weighing ingredients.
The person sweeps the leftover parsley into its bag and stores it away on the countertop.

goals.description: Load used bowls into the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person picks up small bowls and places them into the top drawer of the dishwasher.

goals.description: Retrieve a teaspoon and place it in the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person takes a teaspoon from the cutlery drawer and puts it directly into the dishwasher.
